title: Soft Grunge Reverie — Tumblr Glitter Diary
description: A pixel-grid pastel backdrop frames a deliberately lo-fi Greek bust dusted with scattered sparkle PNGs and crowned by wavy script — channeling peak-2014 Tumblr dashboard nostalgia without a trace of irony.
philosophy: This design exists to honor a specific, unrepeatable moment in internet culture: the 2014 soft-grunge Tumblr aesthetic assembled from found JPEGs, glitter brushes, and curling webfonts. It refuses high-resolution polish and rejects the premise that a slide must be immediately legible or professionally credible. It is built for speakers who want to evoke collective memory — the sensation of scrolling a pastel dashboard at 2 a.m. — rather than transmit structured information. The message it carries fits on one dreamy, wavy line, and that is exactly enough.
goodFor: Single-phrase mood-setting title slides and openers
Creative portfolio intros for Gen Z designers, stylists, or musicians
Personal brand decks in beauty, fashion, or indie music
Nostalgia-driven social media content series and campaign moodboards
avoidFor: Chart-heavy quarterly financial or sales reviews
Academic lecture slides with dense citations or footnotes
Enterprise SaaS or investor pitch decks requiring stakeholder confidence
Multi-column data dashboards where readability is non-negotiable
author: harness

examples.promptCore: The slide should feel like a screenshot lifted straight from a 2014 Tumblr dashboard at 2 a.m. — soft, hazy, and deliberately uncurated. A lo-fi classical bust presides amid drifting glitter and hand-placed star motifs, radiating quiet melancholy and dreamy detachment rather than academic gravity. The composition breathes through asymmetric emptiness: the title floats like a half-formed thought rather than an announcement, and every decorative element feels found rather than designed. Avoid sharp vector precision, symmetric balance, or any atmosphere of corporate legibility — the imperfection is the entire point.

examples.layoutNotes: Full-bleed pixel-grid backdrop with zero outer margin — texture bleeds to every edge with no containing frame. A lo-fi Greek bust anchors the center-right axis, occupying roughly the lower 55% of canvas height and soft-cropped at the bottom edge for intimacy. Wavy script title spans cols 1–8 of a notional 12-col grid, floating in the upper third as a graphic object rather than a text block, with no subtitle band — just open negative space below it. Sparkle and star PNGs scatter asymmetrically across the field, clustering near the bust's crown; no footer, no page number, no ruled lines.

examples.promptCore: The slide should feel like a carefully curated soft-grunge Tumblr post — intimate and slightly melancholic, held together by pastel cohesion rather than rigid structure. Compositional rhythm is asymmetric scatter: phrase fragments drift with subtle rotation while sparkle overlays and lo-fi sticker motifs float freely around them, building translucent layered depth. Draw from the visual language of glitter brushes and curling script laid over washed-out, dreamy found imagery. Avoid anything polished, symmetrical, or immediately scannable — this slide is meant to be felt and lingered over, not read at a glance.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid with live content anchored loosely in columns 3–9; outer columns absorb scattered sparkle-PNG and sticker-style decorative overflow rather than structural margins. Two or three short phrase fragments stack with slight rotational drift — hierarchy is established through size contrast alone, with no rule lines, no header band, and no footer. A lo-fi illustrative element (cropped bust fragment, pressed-flower motif, or translucent sticker form) bleeds into the lower-left quadrant, partially clipped by the frame edge. Page number is omitted; a faint pixel-grid texture runs edge-to-edge as the sole structural ground beneath all layers.
